title: TLR9-mediated activation of the NLRP3 inflammasome in Fusarium solani-induced keratitis.
authors: Zhang, Yanqing; Lin, Yi; Zhang, Yani; Tang, Hanfeng; Hu, Jianzhang; Wang, Bing
one_liner_zh: 该文研究真菌性角膜炎中TLR9对NLRP3炎症小体的调控，虽涉及蛋白互作但非蛋白质-DNA结合体系，且方法以湿实验为主，仅分子对接为辅助，与本课题TF-DNA互作建模无关。
abstract: Toll-like receptor 9 (TLR9) is a crucial innate immune receptor that recognises pathogenic DNA and initiates downstream inflammatory signaling, yet its function in fungal keratitis remains poorly defined. This study aimed to clarify the specific role of TLR9 in Fusarium solani (F. solani) -induced keratitis and to provide mechanistic insights for targeted therapy. A murine model of F. solani keratitis was established to examine the expression and regulation of TLR9 and NLRP3. RNA sequencing, quantitative real-time polymerase chain reaction (qRT-PCR), Western blotting, and immunofluorescence were used to assess gene and protein expression. The activities of TLR9 and NLRP3 were modulated by adeno-associated virus short hairpin RNA (AAV-shRNA), small interfering RNA (siRNA), and pharmacological agents (Nig and MCC950). Disease severity and histopathological alterations were evaluated by slit-lamp examination, clinical scoring, and hematoxylin-eosin staining, while protein interactions were analysed through molecular docking and immunocolocalization. TLR9 and NLRP3 were markedly up-regulated in F. solani-infected corneas. TLR9 silencing suppressed nuclear factor kappaB (NF-kappaB) and NLRP3 activation, thereby mitigating corneal inflammation, reducing stromal oedema, limiting inflammatory cell infiltration, and lowering IL-1beta production. Pharmacological inhibition of NLRP3 with MCC950 produced similar protective effects, whereas activation by nigericin reversed these benefits. In conclusion, TLR9 functions as a pivotal upstream regulator of the NLRP3 inflammasome in F. solani keratitis. These findings uncover a mechanistic link between TLR9 signaling and inflammasome-mediated inflammation, highlighting TLR9 as a potential immunomodulatory target for fungal keratitis therapy.
abstract_zh: Toll样受体9（Toll-like receptor 9, TLR9）是一种关键的先天免疫受体，能够识别病原性DNA并启动下游炎症信号传导，然而其在真菌性角膜炎中的功能仍不明确。本研究旨在阐明TLR9在茄病镰刀菌（Fusarium solani, F. solani）诱导的角膜炎中的具体作用，并为靶向治疗提供机制性见解。建立小鼠F. solani角膜炎模型，以检测TLR9和NLRP3的表达及调控。采用RNA测序、实时定量聚合酶链反应（quantitative real-time polymerase chain reaction, qRT-PCR）、Western blotting和免疫荧光评估基因和蛋白表达。通过腺相关病毒短发夹RNA（adeno-associated virus short hairpin RNA, AAV-shRNA）、小干扰RNA（small interfering RNA, siRNA）及药理试剂（Nig和MCC950）调节TLR9和NLRP3的活性。通过裂隙灯检查、临床评分和苏木精-伊红染色评估疾病严重程度及组织病理学变化，同时利用分子对接和免疫共定位分析蛋白相互作用。TLR9和NLRP3在F. solani感染的角膜中显著上调。TLR9沉默抑制了核因子κB（nuclear factor kappaB, NF-kappaB）和NLRP3的激活，从而减轻角膜炎症、减少基质水肿、限制炎症细胞浸润，并降低IL-1beta的产生。使用MCC950对NLRP3进行药理抑制产生了类似的保护效果，而尼日利亚菌素（nigericin）激活则逆转了这些益处。总之，TLR9在F. solani角膜炎中作为NLRP3炎症小体的关键上游调控因子发挥作用。这些发现揭示了TLR9信号传导与炎症小体介导的炎症之间的机制联系，凸显TLR9作为真菌性角膜炎治疗潜在免疫调节靶点的价值。
